content_of_post_to_answer: Why do we often get caught up in wanting a "better experience," and how can we break free from this mindset?
answer: Wanting a better experience often hides a subtle assumption: that the present moment is a draft version of life, and the real one starts after we upgrade something. The trap is not ambition, but constantly moving the finish line. I’ve written more about this pattern on my profile for those who want to explore it further. A better life is not built by rejecting ordinary moments; it is built by learning not to overlook them.
